changes.headline: The reopen sold the surplus over two confirmed tanker strikes, and the spread slipped back under $7
changes.dek: Both benchmarks opened the week lower on two confirmed tanker strikes; Brent to WTI slipped back under $7 to $6.96. Brent Jan27 was $95.30 at 0427 GMT, down $0.54, and WTI Dec26 was $88.34, down $0.22 (Reuters, Nov 16), after a weekend that contained two confirmed tanker strikes: the VLCC Al Dhannah in the Arabian Gulf on Sunday and an outbound vessel struck by an unknown projectile in the strait at 0558 UTC Monday, with an engine room fire and all crew accounted for in both cases. The Brent to WTI spread is $6.96, back below $7 after two settles above it. The confirmed fundamentals run the other way: the IEA's first surplus of the war at about 1.7 million barrels a day for the fourth quarter, Chinese refinery throughput down 2 percent on the month in October, and Hormuz shipments described by Reuters as nearly restored to pre-war levels.
changes.balance_read: Nothing in the weekend changes a November or December barrel; the basin balance keeps tanking toward December storage of 76.24 million barrels against 80.6 million of working capacity into Tuesday's nominations close, and the price test says the surplus is what the front month is paying for.

changes.headline: Two confirmed tanker strikes in two days, and the sinking claim still has no hull
changes.dek: Two tankers confirmed struck in two days (Al Dhannah on Nov 15, a second vessel outbound on Nov 16), against unconfirmed Iranian claims of two mine strikes and a VLCC sinking. UKMTO cited Indian shipping authorities reporting a tanker attacked in the Arabian Gulf approaching the strait on Nov 15, crew safe, and Vanguard Tech identified her as the Thenamaris VLCC Al Dhannah, struck in the steering gear room and returning toward Dubai. UKMTO then alerted a second vessel struck outbound at 0558 UTC on Nov 16, engine room fire, no casualties, identified by Vanguard as the Panama-flagged On Phoenix off Oman. Both ships sit on PGSA non-compliant lists. Against those two confirmed hits, the IRGC claimed two mine strikes and a VLCC sinking on Sunday with no vessel named and video showing no ship, and the regular navy claimed a further mine strike Sunday night that Reuters could not verify. Bloomberg reports Iran targeted a US helicopter base in Bahrain on Sunday, the first strike on a Gulf state in weeks.
changes.balance_read: The confirmed tempo raises the strait's risk pricing without removing a confirmed barrel this morning; the unconfirmed sinking claim, if it were ever confirmed with a hull, would be a different event, and it has no hull.
changes.vintage: UKMTO reporting via Seatrade Maritime and Reuters, Nov 15 to 16, 2026
changes.publishers: Seatrade Maritime, Nov 16, 2026; Reuters, Nov 16, 2026; Bloomberg, Nov 16, 2026

changes.headline: The Nov 15 Pathways target has passed with no signing announced
changes.dek: The Nov 15 Pathways target has passed with no signing announced as of Monday morning. Nov 15 was the target date for binding agreements between Ottawa, Alberta and the five Oil Sands Alliance producers under the July memorandum, and the grandfathering line for Alberta's Oil Sands Growth Program. As of Monday morning, no signing, announcement or slip notice dated Nov 14, 15 or 16 was found from either government, the Alliance or any of the five producers, so the target has passed unsigned. The Nov 13 program release still quotes Canadian Natural's president as looking forward to finalizing the details of the definitive agreements.
changes.balance_read: Silence keeps the growth and pipeline files conditional while the royalty grandfathering clock runs, against a balance already running about 200 kb/d a month into tanks; a signing announced later would move the pipeline file from conditional to committed, one target date late.
changes.vintage: Direct checks of government, Alliance and producer channels, Nov 16, 2026
changes.publishers: Pathways check, Nov 16, 2026; Government of Alberta, Nov 13, 2026

flags.title: December apportionment: the registered call is Light 14 and Heavy 9, nominations close Nov 17
flags.detail: November Mainline apportionment (Light 19 percent at Kerrobert, Heavy 7 percent at Kerrobert) is in effect. The registered December call is Light 14 percent and Heavy 9 percent. The evidence pack includes the balance build with supply running about 200 kb/d a month above the proven 4,541.6 kb/d egress bound into tanks, a December front month that has not traded in seven sessions on Friday's file, deferred strip widening on volume last week, and a Brent to WTI spread back under $7 at $6.96. December nominations close Tuesday Nov 17 at 0700 MST; the Enbridge notice follows and grades the call. Trigger: The Enbridge December apportionment notice, or a material change in the physical backdrop before the close

flags.title: Confirmed tanker tempo is rising while the sinking claim stays unconfirmed
flags.detail: Two tankers are confirmed struck in two days, the VLCC Al Dhannah on Nov 15 and an outbound vessel at 0558 UTC on Nov 16, both with crews safe. Iranian claims of two further mine strikes and a VLCC sinking carry no named vessel and no confirmation, and the reopen sold both benchmarks anyway. A confirmed sinking or a flow interruption reprices the strait; continued hits without either keep the surplus in charge of the front month. Trigger: A confirmed hull for the claimed sinking from an owner, insurer, tracker or UKMTO product, or a measured flow interruption through the strait

flags.title: Brent positioning has been cut by 111,644 contracts in two weeks; the WTI snapshot lands today
flags.detail: Managed money net long in Brent stands at +133,813 contracts as of Nov 10, the lowest in ten weeks, after cuts of 63,487 and 48,157 in consecutive weeks, with 16,994 fresh shorts added in the second cut. The delayed WTI report for the same date releases today at 3:30 p.m. ET and settles whether the US book flushed the same way into the Nov 4 collapse. Trigger: The delayed CFTC WTI release on Nov 16, or the next ICE Brent report

forward_calendar.what: Delayed CFTC commitments report for Nov 10 positions
forward_calendar.detail: The holiday-delayed report for Nov 10 positions releases at 3:30 p.m. ET. It is the first WTI snapshot capturing the Nov 4 price collapse, and it lands beside the Brent report's second straight large managed-money cut, to a net long of +133,813 with fresh shorts added.

December shipper nominations close at 0700 MST. The registered December call (Light 14 percent, Heavy 9 percent) grades against the Enbridge notice that follows, with December still without a trade after seven sessions on Friday's settlements file.

forward_calendar.what: EIA report for week ending Nov 13, and Irving Osprey resumption date
forward_calendar.detail: The inventory report for the week ending Nov 13 lands Wednesday, after an all-builds print the market rallied through, and the last dated outage in the window is scheduled to resume operations the same day.
The December WTI contract expires Friday, which puts the front differential's first trade, whenever it comes, inside the expiry week.

forward_calendar.what: Athabasca special meeting on the Cenovus arrangement
forward_calendar.detail: Shareholders vote on the plan of arrangement under which Cenovus acquires Athabasca, with closing expected in December.

forward_calendar.what: OPEC+ ministerial meeting on the 2027 framework
forward_calendar.detail: The wider group meets to set the 2027 production framework, with the IEA's November report printing a fourth-quarter surplus and October Gulf exports recovering.
